critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Agent heartbeat interval no longer schedules anything — ensureHeartbeatTask dropped in JobManager migration
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Silent regression: agent background tasks (health checks, timeouts) never fire. Affects all agent sessions. Likely introduced during JobManager refactor.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Agent output stops mid-generation — tool_calls emitted as plain text in thinking block
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Dead-loop: model sends tool_calls in thinking text, parser does not detect them, injects 'no visible output' repeatedly. Unrecoverable without manual stop.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Agent stream stuck/empty after manual interrupt + immediate regenerate
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Reproducible race on stop+regenerate: empty stream (11ms/$0) or frozen UI. Active, assigned.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: dsh startup fails — CHERRY_STUDIO_CODEMATE_*_API_KEY written to .credentials.yaml top-level
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: DSH integration broken for all users; Cherry injects env keys into credentials.yaml where dsh expects only known top-level keys.
